User wants to estimate distance between two cities: 河霧 (hewu?) and 石溪 (shixi?). They want to provide an estimation and then forward via SMS to cousin Bob. Format: "从河霖到石溪的距离是 xxx 公里。" Actually they wrote "從河霧到石溪的距離是 xxx 公里." So we need to estimate distance. We have function estimate_distance(cityA, cityB). But it expects zipcodes? It says arguments: cityA: string, cityB: string. So we can call estimate_distance with city names. Then we need to send SMS to Bob. We need Bob's user id. We can use get_user_id(user="Bob") to get his ID. Then send_message(receiver_id=..., message=...). Also we might need to confirm that we have permission to send SMS. There's no mention of needing to ask permission. We'll just proceed.

We need to estimate distance. Use estimate_distance({"cityA":"河霧","cityB":"石溪"}). Then format message. Then get Bob's user ID. Then send message.

Also we might need to confirm that we have permission to send SMS. There\'s no mention of needing to ask permission. We\'ll just proceed.\n\nWe need to estimate distance. We have function estimate_distance(cityA, cityB). But it expects zipcodes? It says arguments: cityA: string, cityB: string. So we can call estimate_distance with city names. Then we need to send SMS to Bob. We need Bob\'s user id. We can use get_user_id(user="Bob") to get his ID. Then send_message(receiver_id=..., message=...). Also we might need to confirm that we have permission to send SMS. There\'s no mention of needing to ask permission. We\'ll just proceed.\n\nWe need to estimate distance. Use estimate_distance({"cityA":"河霧","cityB":"石溪"}). Then format message. Then get Bob\'s user ID. Then send message.')
